description: Verify JWT_SECRET_KEY environment variable is configured in pod with strong secret (>=32 chars, not default)

input.command: kubectl exec -n metabob deployment/metabob-rpc-api -- env | grep '^JWT_SECRET_KEY='

passCriteria: JWT_SECRET_KEY environment variable exists in pod
Value is not the weak default 'development-secret-key-change-in-production'
Value appears to be a random hex string
